verdict.rationale: Puzzle is an API-backed accounting platform, so subscribing to events via webhooks is a fair question for it. The evidence documents a REST API (OpenAPI spec, sandbox, Try It console) and an MCP server, but nothing about registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions. A request/response API and an MCP server are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
